Name: Black Cat (Stardew Valley 1.4 NOV 2019)
Author: bookshelph
Description:
Three black cat skins for the update 1.4, which brings in 3 different skins for dog/cat.

This replaces cat1; AKA The grey cat / second option for cat.

Does [b]not [/b]change the icon on the character reaction menu, make sure you choose the grey cat for it to show up!

You can choose standard, heterochromia, or "Tater" (based off a real 3-legged cat!)
Enjoy. <3

[b]Note[/b]: As of the newupdate you can change your cat's skin at the Shrine of Illusions, which you unlock by befriending the wizard. You can also rename the file to 'cat.xnb' or 'cat2.xnb' to replace one of the other cat skins instead of they grey one.

Installation:

[list=1]
[*]Navigate to xxx:\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals

[*]Backup 'cat1.xnb'
[*]Unzip the download
[*]Replace the existing 'cat1.xnb' with the appropriate black cat.
[*]Select the second cat skin (Grey and White) upon character reaction
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
